info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Practice Areas API
Return the data for all PracticeAreas

params.name: code
params.description: Filter PracticeArea records to those that match the given code.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter PracticeArea records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter PracticeArea records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of PracticeArea records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Filter PracticeArea records to exclude Legal Aid UK Practice Areas when activities exist on the matter.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter PracticeArea records to those that match the given name.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the PracticeArea records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter PracticeArea records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
